title: poa angustifolia subsp. anceps
intro: Poa angustifolia subsp. anceps, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a subspecies of grass that is native to various parts of the world, including North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known to offer several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
